messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "this is not what most people pay"
set: ["this is not what most people pay", "not what most people pay", "this list is not complete", "most people are told not to eat less potassium", "this applies to most brands of levothyroxine", "ask your doctor what is reasonable for you", "doctor will decide what is right for you", "what is the Zepbound Coupon or Savings Card", "What is the Mounjaro Coupon or Savings Card?", "most settle after the medicine is stopped", "irregular heartbeat is most commonly atrial fibrillation", "this is not a complete list of side effects", "most people are told to eat more potassium", "1 to 4 days: most people feel full benefit", "this is normal and will not make the medicine less effective", "this list is not complete and many other drugs may interact"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
